segments.label: NEWS
segments.headline: Tesla opens Cybercab orders, by invite

beats.narration: When you buy a car, you can drive it anywhere you like. So what do you get with Tesla's car that has no steering wheel?
Until now, Tesla kept its self-driving Cybercab in its own fleet. Now it's inviting select buyers.
The estimated price is just under thirty thousand dollars.
But without a paid monthly subscription, it won't operate at all.
And it only drives in areas Tesla allows.
A bit like a phone that only works on an active plan.

visual.text: Like a phone on a plan
visual.sub: you own it · it drives only where, and while, Tesla allows

beats.narration: Teslarati says the fine print redefines what owning a car means.
It's invite-only, and delivery is only an estimate.
What Elon Musk said about the price is in this week's full episode. Link below.
